scope.live: public ordinary user-agent GET; not verified Googlebot IP

graphRules: Exclude self links. ORPHAN=zero unique incoming canonical sources; NEAR_ORPHAN=one; WEAK=<=1 contextual source or depth null/>3; STRONG=homepage or >=2 contextual sources plus logical hub link and depth<=2; otherwise NORMAL. Structural triage, not ranking scores. Contextual means <main> outside nav/header/footer, not proof of prose placement.

findings.title: One canonical sitemap URL has no incoming rendered link
findings.evidence: 0 incoming links from all 260 indexable canonical pages; null homepage depth; local and deployed link targets match. HTTP 200, self-canonical and sitemap-listed.
findings.why: This one intended public tool has no crawlable discovery path within the canonical graph. It does not explain sitewide Google weakness.
findings.recommendedAction: In a separately authorized patch, add one appropriate contextual entry point to the existing advisor if it is intentionally public. Do not add links to all pages.
findings.changeRisk: Low: one editorial link; validate usefulness and tool purpose first.

findings.title: Combined host/protocol/slash variants take multiple redirects
findings.evidence: Complete canonical HTTP/HTTPS × www/non-www × slash/no-slash matrix recorded in redirect-integrity.csv. No internal links or sitemap entries use these variants. All end at 200 self-canonicals; no loops.
files: Production Cloudflare host/protocol normalization (not fully represented in repository)
findings.why: Avoidable crawl hops, limited to alternate external entry points. The 68 configured historical aliases already take one 301.
findings.recommendedAction: Optional future edge-rule consolidation after exporting the actual deployed rules; do not add per-URL redirect lists or arbitrary garbage redirects.
findings.changeRisk: Medium: edge routing affects every URL; not a reason for an urgent sitewide patch.

findings.title: Product schema and visible product experience use different text selections
findings.evidence: 103 reviewBody strings absent as exact visible text; 22 negativeNotes strings on 19 products need semantic comparison. Some are visibly paraphrased. One confirmed inappropriate note on neakasa-m1-lite exposes internal Lifecycle-Owner route metadata as a product disadvantage. All JSON parses; 103 visible editorial ratings, no AggregateRating; 67 offers on 60 products identify external sellers.
findings.why: A rich-result fidelity concern. Exact wording differences are warnings, not proof of fabricated reviews or a ranking penalty. One internal implementation note is definitely not a reader-visible product disadvantage.
findings.recommendedAction: In a later scoped patch, align schema selections with visible review content and omit the internal lifecycle note. Preserve actual editorial scores and unknown identifiers. Resolve warnings semantically before changing them.
findings.changeRisk: Low-medium: incorrect deduplication could remove valid pros/cons; preserve visible content and source evidence.

findings.title: Four near-orphans and four lightly supported editorial destinations
findings.evidence: Four pages each have one unique incoming source. Three are products linked only by their manufacturer; seniorenhunde-richtig-versorgen is linked only from /wissen/. Four other editorial pages have <=1 contextual incoming source. All reachable in <=3 clicks.
findings.why: Localized topical support gaps. Direct hub links are absent for 135 pages under the inherited cluster mapping; absence alone is not a defect. Legal/navigation destinations are not content-link problems.
findings.recommendedAction: Review relevance only when these pages are editorially updated; use a natural same-topic guide/comparison connection if it helps readers. No mass linking.
findings.changeRisk: Low if selective; medium if applied mechanically.

findings.title: Lastmod is editorial-source-based but does not cover all meaningful derived changes
findings.evidence: 248 dates originate from updatedAt ?? publishedAt; 12 static routes omit lastmod. No build-clock default. Furbo has lastmod 2026-08-15, while commit 8db22020 on 2026-09-09 changed displayed price 81 → 98. Automatic check timestamps alone are not meaningful edits.
findings.why: LASTMOD_PARTIALLY_TRUSTWORTHY: no invented freshness, but source dates do not fully track derived visible/structured changes. 248 is the date-bearing population, not 248 proven inaccurate dates.
findings.recommendedAction: Retain real source dates; document meaningful-update ownership. If an accurate date cannot be established for a route, omit it. Do not substitute deploy time or routine price-check time.
findings.changeRisk: Low; false freshness would be riskier than omission.

findings.title: Existing strict price audit fails for two missing affiliate destinations
findings.evidence: price:audit:strict exit 1 because missingAffiliate=2; missingPrice=1, stale30=41. Neither affected product emits an Offer. Unknown availability is retained; no fabricated merchant offer observed.
findings.why: A maintenance/gate exception, not an indexing blocker. Missing commercial destinations may be deliberate for uncertain products.
findings.googleSupport: No Google requirement to invent an affiliate link or an unknown price.
findings.recommendedAction: Use the existing product-maintenance workflow to determine whether the omissions are intentional; do not invent values to turn the gate green.
findings.changeRisk: Low if reviewed; high factual risk if guessed.

findings.title: Publisher slugs are emitted as SKU identifiers
findings.evidence: Product.sku = contentProduct.slug. No MPN/GTIN is fabricated; manufacturer and brand roles are not confused with seller.
findings.why: No demonstrated ranking/indexing effect. A publisher-local identifier must not be presented as a verified manufacturer SKU.
findings.recommendedAction: Document as publisher-local or omit during a future schema cleanup; do not replace with guessed identifiers.

findings.title: Older URL audit miscounts noindex pages
findings.evidence: audit-url-consistency reports 262 indexable pages because its regex uses a double-escaped word boundary; independent parse5 extraction and existing baseline both report 260. Existing audit exits 0.
findings.why: Audit-confidence issue only. Production noindex signals are correct. This package uses actual HTML parsing rather than accepting that counter.
findings.recommendedAction: Consolidate the legacy parser in a future tooling cleanup; use the attached URL matrix as the current measured denominator.

decision.qualification: No observed sitewide technical mechanism explains extremely low visibility. Public GETs cannot prove Google-selected canonicals, actual Googlebot delivery, or index-coverage reasons.
decision.patchScope: Separate, minimal work package for the one P1 orphan; schema fidelity cleanup can be included only if explicitly authorized. No patch applied.
decision.technicalSeoFreeze: NO — limited P1 remains; freeze broad canonical, sitemap, rendering and performance redesign.

gscCorrelation.evidenceStrength: Unavailable for exclusion causality; complete current technical census

validation.electron: Unavailable; installed Chrome reused identical existing metrics, thresholds, routes and viewports.
validation.contentQuality: Existing collectContentQuality run without generated/source writes; zero findings.
